annotations.title: Audit Code & PR for EU Compliance

description: Audit a code diff, package.json dependencies, or source code snippet for EU AI Act obligations, non-EEA cloud data transfers, and prompt retention exposure. Generates a review-ready GitHub PR comment or CI/CD compliance report.

diff_or_code.description: Git diff, package.json contents, or source code snippet to audit.

project_name.description: Project or repository name (optional, defaults to 'Current Project').

name: audit_repo_pull_request

outputSchema.description: Code audit report with complianceStatus, detectedServices, triggeredArticles, and prCommentMarkdown.
